platform.lengthSemantics: Frontmatter px values represent DIP at 96 DPI; UiPx converts them for each native window.
platform.fontMetrics: GDI measures line height and wrapped text; no fixed CSS line-height or letter-spacing is asserted.
platform.componentRepresentation: Native metadata only. The existing browser comparison prototype is a reference, not the production implementation.

body.purpose: Voice preview content, empty-content guidance, and candidate words.

status.purpose: The native voice overlay's current phase or recovery condition.

label.purpose: Action hints, scroll hints, candidate indices, and settings entry.

elevation.mechanism: Native window shadow plus solid surfaces, selection fills, and rules.
elevation.ownership: Windows determines shadow rendering; the project defines no CSS shadow parameters.
elevation.paintStrategy: UiPaintFrame submits a complete offscreen frame to avoid background-only flashes.

appearance.menu: Shared native Windows skin submenu with a radio mark for the current selection.
appearance.saveFailure: Keep the previous skin and notify the user to retry.
appearance.apply: Save the preference, repaint the voice overlay, and broadcast VoiceIme.AppearanceChanged to existing candidate windows; new windows read the saved selection.

layout.model: Caret-anchored, non-activating native popups constrained to the monitor work area.
layout.responsiveBehavior: Per-window DPI scaling and work-area clamping; no web breakpoints.

voice.overflow: Whole-font-line viewport with scrollbar and explicit end-of-content hint.

candidates.sizing: GDI-measured words share available width; truncation retains full tooltip and accessible names.

states.confirmation: Enter during recording stops and finalizes; a subsequent confirmation inserts the final preview. Enter during finalization does not queue insertion.
states.candidates: Selected styling takes precedence over hover; ordinary hover retains the normal text roles, while high-contrast hover uses the system highlight foreground.
states.motion: Immediate state redraws with no authored animation. Unchanged content and anchors avoid redundant moves, paints, and visibility changes.
states.focus: WS_EX_NOACTIVATE / MA_NOACTIVATE keep the text application's focus.

evidence.provenance: Captured from this project's real native UI by its UI test tool; not generated images or third-party assets.
evidence.reviewScope: The final verdict resolves the scored visual findings; it is not a claim of complete human acceptance.
evidence.acceptanceBoundary: Human microphone use in user applications, physical multi-monitor operation, and screen-reader acceptance remain separate. High-contrast screenshots exercise an injected test branch.

narrative.overview:
Simple Voice 的原生 Windows 浮层以可读文字和明确状态形成干净、克制的科技感。语音预览与拼音候选使用同一套字体、色彩职责和边界细节，保持输入内容在视觉上的主导地位。科技感来自精确的分区、细线与低饱和强调色。

用户已确认钛银、极昼、深空三套皮肤全部内置并可切换。默认钛银的冷银灰与深青呈现仪表分节；极昼用净白、蓝色和连续圆角表达轻盈；深空用石墨、冰青和细轮廓适应暗色编辑环境。三套共用布局与行为，Windows 高对比度颜色始终优先。
keyCharacteristics: 文字为主，状态与操作提示分层清楚。
同一输入浮层结构承载三套完整皮肤。
实色表面、细线图标与适量圆角。
浮层不激活，换肤保留正在进行的输入。

rules.name: The Shared Roles Rule
rules.body: 换肤改变一整组色彩角色，语音与候选同步使用；状态意义、文字层级和操作位置不随皮肤变化。

rules.name: The System Contrast Rule
rules.body: Windows 高对比度开启时，背景取 `COLOR_WINDOW`，正文与次要文字取 `COLOR_WINDOWTEXT`，选中与 hover 底色取 `COLOR_HIGHLIGHT`，其上的候选正文、序号和设置文字取 `COLOR_HIGHLIGHTTEXT`。系统配色覆盖皮肤配色，并恢复可见外轮廓。

rules.name: The Readable Small Text Rule
rules.body: 操作提示与候选序号使用同一小字层级；空间不足时先换行或限制容器，而不是继续缩小文字。

rules.name: The Stable Input Rule
rules.body: 相同内容和锚点不重复移动、显隐或重绘；换肤只更新圆角与绘制，不重新定位浮层、不重启录音、不清空预览、不改变候选选择或滚动位置，也不让隐藏浮层重新出现。

dos: Do 同步使用同一皮肤的语音与候选角色，保留共享的字号、布局和状态语义。
Do 以原生 DIP 与实际字体测量布局，检查正常、选中、hover、长文和高对比状态。
Do 让 Windows 高对比度颜色覆盖预设皮肤，并保持系统高亮底上的对应文字颜色。
Do 换肤时保留输入、预览、选词、滚动位置和窗口可见状态。
Do 以真实原生截图核对实现，保留截图来源与测试范围。
donts: Don't 将浏览器比较板的宽度、三列排版或按钮设计当作原生输入法规范。
Don't 用更浅的小字、大面积霓虹、装饰动效或透明模糊表达未来感。
Don't 为换肤添加新的确认步骤、重启要求或未经批准的自动深浅切换。
Don't 把高对比度测试分支或截图审查写成真人使用验收结果。
